Fig. 2: Examples of the generated report on the MIMIC-CXR dataset, compared against Base-1, which does not utilize gaze. Our model successfully generated critical terms such as small bilateral pleural effusions, aorta shows diffuse calcification, left upper lung, and osseous abnormalities, which were absent in the baseline-generated report. Additionally, our method demonstrates greater clinical precision, using terms like mild signs of pulmonary edema instead of mild fluid congestion.
